sentences.text: Issue notice to the opposite party no. 2, both under registered cover with A/D as well as ordinary process for which Patna High Court CR.

MISC. No.62042 of 2023(2) dt.19-10-2023 requisites etc.
must be filed on or before 10.11.2023, failing which this application, as against opposite party no. 2,
shall stand rejected without further reference to a Bench.

In the meantime, the opeartion of the order dated 09.01.2023 passed by the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Banka in connection with Shambhuganj P.S. Case No. 83 of 2021 whereby cognizance of the offences under Sections 420 and 406/34 of the Indian Penal Code read with Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act has been taken against the petitioners shall remain stayed as it has been submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioners that the marriage of the daughter of opposite party no. 2 was fixed with petitioner no. 3 who is son of petitioner no. 2 and petitioner no. 1 is wife of petitioner no. 2 and petitioner no. 4 is own brother of petitioner no. 3.
It is further submitted that the marriage could not materialize on account of which, the present false case came to be instituted.

(Satyavrat Verma, J) Kundan/-
